body: T15 WRONG ANSWER 3RD ATTEMPT ERROR STATE SPEC. PROBLEM: After 3 wrong attempts Kai has no clear path forward. Current: feedback shows incorrect in red. No state change. No explicit escalation. STATES: attempt-1 (wrong): red feedback, hint button appears. attempt-2 (wrong): red feedback, hint button stays, no visual change. attempt-3 (wrong): ESCALATED STATE. ESCALATED STATE DEFINITION: Card gains .escalated class. Visual changes: left border 4px solid rgba(255,163,0,0.9) amber, not red. Background: rgba(255,163,0,0.04) very subtle amber wash. Feedback text changes to amber color. New CTA appears: SHOW ANSWER button (now always visible, not hidden). TRANSITIONS: attempt-1 to attempt-2: no transition, just repeat. attempt-2 to attempt-3: 200ms border color change red to amber. escalated to resolved (answer shown): amber fades to neutral over 400ms. WHY AMBER NOT RED: Red signals emergency, wrong, stop. Amber signals caution, review, try differently. On the 3rd attempt Kai needs to shift strategy not to feel punished. Amber is the UI equivalent of the coach saying ok let's look at this together. ACCEPT: 3rd wrong answer triggers .escalated class. Border changes to amber 200ms. SHOW ANSWER is visible. Amber resolves when hint expanded.
